title: Customer upgrade pathways and communications toolkit for LTS & rolling releases
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable, customer-facing communications kit and upgrade pathway artifacts that cover LTS channel upgrades, rolling releases, rollout gates, and upgrade tooling. Deliverables: (1) a plain-language upgrade timeline and migration checklist for customers, (2) email and in-console message templates for segmented cohorts, (3) versioning matrix + compatibility table, (4) rollback and escalation playbook, and (5) sample changelog formatting for major/minor/LTS releases.
acceptance_criteria: A concise one-page upgrade checklist (PDF/HTML) that customers can follow for runtime-1.20 LTS migration
Email and in-console templates ready for A/B testing across three customer cohorts (self-serve, enterprise, and regulated)
Changelog examples that meet our structured output and function-calling guidelines (human-readable and machine-parseable)
Compatibility matrix published in Console release notes and linked in customer emails
Rollback and support escalation playbook validated by Support and SRE teams
notes: Target audience: platform integrators, SREs at customer orgs, and product teams who depend on predictable inference behavior.
Key constraints: cannot require customers to perform manual model-compatibility recompiles; prefer automated migration where possible using our upgrade tooling.
We must align messaging with Dedicated and Private SLAs — include explicit guidance for Dedicated/Private upgrade windows and support contacts.
Coordinate with Legal/Compliance on wording for deprecation timelines when policy or security patches are involved.

comm_templates:
Pre-upgrade email (6 weeks): Subject: Upcoming runtime-1.20 LTS: what to expect and how to prepare
Body: TL;DR of key changes, recommended action (test in staging), links to compatibility matrix and migration checklist, scheduled canary windows and opt-out info, contact for Concierge migration support (Dedicated/Private customers)

Upgrade window reminder (2 weeks): Subject: runtime-1.20 LTS: scheduled rollout window for your account
Body: Specific date/time windows by region, expected downtime (none for hosted; best-effort for Dedicated during node maintenance), steps if you need to reschedule, link to rollback instructions and how to open a priority ticket

Post-upgrade summary (day-of): Subject: runtime-1.20 LTS successful upgrade — summary & rollback details
Body: What changed in this upgrade, known issues triage status, how to revert to prior model variant if needed, telemetry dashboard link, feedback survey
In-console banner (channelized): Short copy for targeting tiers: "runtime-1.20 LTS upgrade coming — review migration checklist" + CTA linking to account-scoped checklist and test harness

Changelog headline format: "[runtime-1.20 | LTS] Summary line — 2–3 bullets; Breaking changes: list; Migration steps: list; Deprecated: list; Affected APIs/routes: list; Machine metadata: JSON-LD block URL"
migration_checklist: Inventory: list routes & pinned model versions in your account via Console -> Routes
Smoke tests: run provided test-suite against staging with runtime-1.20 images (link to GH action)
KV cache validation: verify prefix caching behavior for long-context routes (recommended kv-cache-size setting)
Autoscaling config: confirm burst windows and policy for Dedicated customers; add extra capacity for canary cohort
Rollout: opt into canary cohort (5% traffic) for 48 hours before account-wide rollout
Fallback: configure auto-fallback to previous compatible model variant and validate TTLs for cached prefixes
rollback_playbook: Trigger conditions: error rate >3x baseline for 30m or latency >2x SLO for 15m across critical routes
Immediate steps: switch traffic to last-known-good model variant using Console rollback button; disable batching changes introduced in runtime-1.20
Support escalation: open Priority-1 ticket and notify oncall-sre@redwood.com with subject containing customer key and incident timestamp
Postmortem: capture traces, relevant logs, and customer-provided repro; include eval prompt sets to reproduce failure in sandbox
